mechanics.claim: Hitting an enemy champion creates an explosion dealing additional physical damage to nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: Hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} creates an explosion that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: Subsequent explosions against the same target deal 75% of the previous explosion's damage, so repeated hits on the dummy decay.
mechanics.quote: subsequent explosions against the same target dealing 75% damage of the previous explosion's damage

mechanics.claim: The glob slows down in missile speed after traveling a distance, changing time to hit.
mechanics.quote: slowing down in missile speed after travelling {{tt|1200|estimated}} units

mechanics.claim: Smolder cannot basic attack for a brief moment after the cast, delaying on-hit follow-up.
mechanics.quote: Smolder can't declare basic attacks for a brief moment after the cast time.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield can block either the glob or the explosion, but not both, so it cannot negate all of the ability's damage.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield can block either the glob or the explosion, but not both.
